piezas.titulo: Speaking practice: Routine and immediate needs
texto: End of the Novice section (CU-TFL Novice / TPA T1): communicative integration of polite phrases, introductions, shopping, directions and routines. At this level, the goal is to produce short, memorable sentences fluently, answer simple questions about your everyday life and handle immediate needs successfully in Thailand. Well done on building the foundation of the language!

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «การพักผ่อนอย่างมีคุณภาพและการนอนหลับเพียงพอช่วยเติมพลังสำหรับวันต่อไป» express?

opciones.texto: Quality rest and restful sleep renew your energy for tomorrow.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «การพักผ่อนอย่างมีคุณภาพและการนอนหลับเพียงพอช่วยเติมพลังสำหรับวันต่อไป» from the text.

opciones.texto: Organising your daily schedule helps balance work and rest.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the text, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Getting up early and exercising regularly benefits your health in the long term.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.
